raw_segments.text: Yes, a means of escape had come. It had been too stifling, too cramping, the burden had
been too agonizing. A lethargy had come upon him at times. From the moment of the scene
with Nicolay at poor fairies, he had been suffocating, penned in without hope of escape.
After Nicolay's confession, on that very day had come the scene with Sonya. His behavior
and his last words had been utterly unlike anything he could have imagined beforehand.
He had grown feebler instantly and fundamentally. And he had agreed at the time with Sonya.
He had agreed in his heart he could not go on living alone with such a thing on his mind.
